retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait within a thick black rounded-corner frame, surrounded by a wide solid-color border with stacked, high-contrast serif typography at the top.
excludeWhen: grunge or distressed street art styles

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured layout featuring a central photographic window with heavily rounded corners, set against a vibrant, solid-color background. The top section contains two lines of text: a black serif name and a larger, yellow serif title, creating a clear hierarchy against the warm backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait framed by a thick black rounded-corner border
Stacked typography aligned to the top-left of the frame
High-contrast color relationship between the red background and yellow text
Balanced negative space in the outer margins
coreInvariants: Thick black border with a radius of approximately 15% of the frame width
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with the second line significantly larger than the first
Solid, saturated background color surrounding the central element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait occupying approximately 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick black rounded frame acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down to the central portrait, and rests on the framed subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid-color margins on all four sides of the central frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the frame and primary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the secondary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high-value yellow text for maximum legibility.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly tracked letters to create a cohesive block of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked same-family serifs with contrasting colors and sizes.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid terracotta red background with a large, centered, thick black rounded-corner frame containing a mid-century style portrait.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase high-contrast serif text in the top-left corner; the first line in black and the second, larger line in bright yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the frame corner radius sufficiently large?
Is the yellow text significantly larger than the black text?
Is the background a solid, warm red tone?
Is the text aligned to the left edge of the inner frame?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the frame corners are rounded, not square.
Ensure the text does not overlap the black frame.
Verify the high-contrast serif style is maintained.
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + Rounded frame portrait + Stacked high-contrast serif header.
